messages:
Elena (FinOps): Hi team — ComputeLedger sent a renewal with a new 'dynamic quantization' surcharge and a higher minimum commit. Our Q1 export doesn't line up with their billed units. Can someone validate before we reply to Sales? Link: drive.redwood/vendor/computeledger/renewal-2026 (redacted)

Tom (Procurement): The minimum commit jumped from $7k/mo to $11k/mo. They also added a recurring "support-oncall" fee of $1,200/mo that wasn't in our PO.

Jules (SRE): We moved some workloads to their quantized instance in Feb; that should lower per-token cost, not add a surcharge called "dynamic quantization". Curious how they calculate that.

Elena (FinOps): Sam, can you pull the billing export and show our billed units vs their invoice INV-2026-0810?

Sam (BillingBot): Billing export link: /billing/exports/computeledger-2026-q1.csv. Snapshot: Q1 computeledgers tokens = 2,140,912, reserved hours = 4,320h, invoiced amount INV-2026-0810 = $92,740.

Tom (Procurement): Ravi from ComputeLedger, can you explain the surcharge and the new min-commit math? Also why support-oncall appears now? We never agreed to that in last term.

Ravi (ComputeLedger): Hi all — thanks for flagging. The "dynamic quantization" is a per-request CPU-adaptive step we started charging on optimized instances; it's intended to pass through additional CPU overhead for mixed-precision conversions. Support-oncall was introduced for 24/7 escalation on the Enterprise plans — it should have been optional. Apologies if it landed in the template. We can remove it. For min-commit, we increased baseline to ensure cross-region warm caches for your low-latency SLA.

Jules (SRE): Removing support-oncall helps. But please produce a line-by-line map: our request_ids -> their billed units for Jan-Mar so we can reconcile. If the dynamic quantization is applied, show where and why.

Elena (FinOps): Also ask for two pro-forma variants: (A) their quoted baseline with quantization surcharge + warm caches, (B) previous baseline (no warm caches) + optional warm cache addon, (C) per-use pricing with a 3-month pilot and the quantization surcharge disabled. For each variant include deltas vs our Jan-Mar actuals.

Nora (Legal): If they want to add quantization charges mid-term we need explicit language: any new pass-through fees require 90-day notice and written consent. Add that as a negotiation item. For the invoice INV-2026-0810 discrepancy, we need a credit or written explanation.

Sam (BillingBot): Please attach the invoice. Reference: /invoices/INV-2026-0810.pdf

Ravi (ComputeLedger): Understood. I'll produce: (1) full pro-forma CSV with three variants; (2) a reconciliation CSV mapping request_id -> their_units -> our_units for Jan-Mar; (3) a note on quantization logic including sample request_ids. ETA: 24 hours.

Tom (Procurement): If they can't produce an itemized reconcile within 24hrs, escalate to account manager for a temporary invoice hold on INV-2026-0810.

Elena (FinOps): Also include a credit for INV-2026-0810 if reconciliation shows overbilling. We prefer a credit on the next invoice rather than a refund.

Jules (SRE): For our local check I run:```SELECT request_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(*) as calls FROM api.requests WHERE vendor='computeledger' AND day BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY request_id;``` Paste results so we can cross-check quickly.

Ravi (ComputeLedger): I'll include a short script we run to extract billed units and the mapping.

Nora (Legal): Add an audit clause to the SOW draft: quarterly reconciliation rights for differences >0.5% and 30-day remediation window. I'll draft suggested language once they post their SOW.

Tom (Procurement): Decision deadline: 2026-04-20. Please lock negotiations and have a recommended option by then.

Sam (BillingBot): Reminder set: computeledger-renewal-decision 2026-04-20 09:00 PT

Elena (FinOps): Thanks. Once Ravi posts the files we'll run the sim and reply with either (1) accept variant B with warm-cache opt-in, (2) accept per-use pilot, or (3) request credit + delay renewal.

Ravi (ComputeLedger): Uploading pro-forma + recon now. DM me for urgent follow-ups.
